fix_summary: validate_quantities only rejects negative quantities (quantity < 0), allowing zero to pass despite the requirement for a positive quantity. Change the check to `<= 0` to reject zero-quantity lines.
suggested_test: Create an order with a single line having quantity 0 and assert that validate(order) returns False (or raises ValidationError if calling validate_quantities directly). Example: order = {"region":"EMEA","contact_email":"a@b","lines":[{"sku":"X","quantity":0}]}; assert not validate(order).
